# Imagery fixture

`wac-global-z0-x0-y0.jpg` is the original 256 by 256 Moon Trek JPEG fetched on
2026-11-15 from:

```text
https://trek.nasa.gov/tiles/Moon/EQ/LRO_WAC_Mosaic_Global_303ppd_v02/1.0.0/default/default028mm/0/0/0.jpg
```

Credit: NASA / LRO / LROC; served by Moon Trek.

API and bundled Worker tests use these bytes offline to check binary responses.
